name: rosetta-greedy-algorithm-for-egyptian-fractions
code:
use default

egyptian(numerator: bigint, denominator: bigint)
        -> Pipe[bigint] is
    let top mut = numerator
    let bottom mut = denominator

    while top > 0n do
        let unit = (bottom + top - 1n) / top

        yield unit

        top = top * unit - bottom
        bottom = bottom * unit
    od
si

describe(numerator: int, denominator: int) -> string is
    let whole = numerator / denominator
    let terms = LIST()

    if whole > 0 then
        terms.add("[{whole}]")
    fi

    let rest = egyptian(
        cast(numerator % denominator),
        cast(denominator))

    for unit in rest do
        terms.add("1/{unit}")
    od

    return "{numerator}/{denominator} = {terms |> join(" + ")}"
si

for (numerator, denominator) in [(43, 48), (5, 121), (2014, 59)] do
    write_line(describe(numerator, denominator))
od

report(limit: int) is
    let most_terms mut = (numerator = 0, denominator = 1, terms = 0)
    let widest mut =
        (numerator = 0, denominator = 1, unit = 0n)

    for denominator in 2::limit do
        for numerator in 1..denominator do
            let count mut = 0
            let last mut = 0n

            let units = egyptian(
                cast(numerator), cast(denominator))

            for unit in units do
                count = count + 1
                last = unit
            od

            if count > most_terms.terms then
                most_terms = (numerator, denominator, count)
            fi

            if last > widest.unit then
                widest = (numerator, denominator, last)
            fi
        od
    od

    write_line("")
    let (numerator, denominator, terms) = most_terms

    write_line("for proper fractions with terms up to {limit}:")
    write_line("  most terms: {numerator}/{denominator} with {terms} terms")
    let (top, bottom, unit) = widest

    write_line("  largest denominator: {top}/{bottom}")
    write_line("    with {unit.to_string().length} digits: {unit}")
si

report(99)
report(999)
